current_scope: Recommendation/proof only. No source edits, probe/test, actual plan or invocation; all current failures, Sources and resource predicates remain frozen. Native RSS accounting under declared fixed-source ownership is not a universal OS-enforced hard cap.
decision: Prefer a prospective two-epoch maximum after an authenticated all-reaped/no-future-spawn cutoff. Keep the existing conservative gate until this small protocol change is Source-reviewed, preregistered and qualified. Do not subtract rolled-up child peaks or replace terminal evidence with an earlier SELF sample.
fallback: If a complete no-spawn cutoff or ABI upper-bound argument cannot be qualified simply, keep the safe current additive certificate and reduce actual full-model/serialization memory under it. Lowering memory changes no measurement authority, but must preserve the complete model and be measured; it is not yet known to suffice.
preservation_argument: For any time at or before the cutoff, caller RSS is at most its later SELF high-water; complete child-lifetime weights bound simultaneous owned child RSS, and the observer certificate bounds observer RSS. Their sum bounds every pre-cut aggregate state.

After cutoff, the no-spawn condition and complete reaping leave only the caller in owned scope. Inclusive terminal wait4 is still an upper bound on that caller exit-tail RSS. Taking the maximum therefore covers both epochs without adding the same rolled-up descendant peak again. This is a proposed proof conditional on the listed evidence, not a changed current gate.

published_semantics.support: Apple documents terminal wait4 resource information for the process and its children, so the returned peak cannot be assumed exclusive SELF.
Published calcru obtains task resident_size_max for SELF; ruadd merges ru_maxrss by maximum. Thus subtracting descendant peak cannot recover a parent-exclusive peak.
Published exit handling copies SELF usage and merges child usage before retaining terminal rusage.
Current published XNU manual specifies ru_maxrss bytes. The older archived Apple getrusage page says kilobytes; do not apply that archival unit to this already-qualified Darwin byte ABI.

required_before_production: Genuine Root scope/preregistration and distinct Source review of cutoff, native endpoint/default/cell custody, all paths after cutoff and the changed closer. No retrospective relabeling of current UNKNOWN runs.

Complete birth-bound launch occurrences, true wait4 PID/status/rusage, observer intervals, no leftovers and ordinary fixed-Source no-escape/no-unregistered-fork assumption. Each role is a leaf or has a complete recursive bound.

Capture SELF only after every child/observer terminal and seal before any possible later process creation; ledger counts and full immutable records cannot change thereafter. Audit interpreter finalization/atexit/signal paths or use a reviewed minimal no-spawn native exit tail.

Authenticate strict integer byte values/native resource endpoints/current ABI, original global clock and cutoff brackets; confirm terminal T is at least recorded cutoff SELF and each known rolled-up peak. Inconsistency or incomplete native evidence yields UNKNOWN.

Meaningful separate controls: known overlap of two children, large child plus small parent, parent tail growth after seal, attempted post-seal child/observer spawn, missing/reused PID or missing terminal row, and cancellation/final output tail. These are future obligations only; none executed here.
Original global20/failure55/owned60/aggregate512MiB/caller90+finish1 and all output/EOF/cancellation gates remain. Every cutoff/ledger/serialization/reconciliation cost is charged.

variables.SELF: \(S_\tau\): native SELF resident high-water sampled at the authenticated cutoff, covering every caller allocation from process birth through that sample.
variables.children: \(P_i\): terminal per-leaf native resident peak, on the conservative closed interval \(I_i=[a_i,b_i]\), with start before Popen and end after true wait4.
variables.cutoff: \(\tau\): after every owned child and native observer is truly terminal/reaped, before the final SELF sample. No new owned process can be spawned from then through true caller exit.
variables.observers: \(O\): certified bound on simultaneous owned observer RSS. The current serialized observer model may use its complete maximum; otherwise preserve its own overlap sum.
variables.overlap: \(C=\max_t\sum_{i:t\in I_i}P_i\): complete weighted lifetime-overlap bound, using starts before ends on ties.
variables.terminal: \(T\): actual external wait4 peak of the exact caller through true exit. It is inclusive, but must dominate the caller SELF peak through exit. External meter/probe memory exclusions remain explicitly the established instrument scope.

why_other_shortcuts_fail: Terminal wait4 alone is a maximum over rolled-up peaks, not the sum of concurrently live children. It cannot replace the existing weighted overlap certificate.
Subtracting a largest child from a maximum loses parent information; replacing terminal SELF by a smaller earlier observation misses exit-tail allocations.
Taking a two-epoch maximum without an enforced cutoff is unsound: parent growth after the sample could still overlap a live/new child.
An inclusive child peak is only a valid leaf weight when that role cannot spawn descendants; otherwise its entire subtree needs a recursively sound simultaneous bound and complete lineage.
